children: URGES CUSTOMERS TO PREPARE AS PLANNED PUBLIC SAFETY POWER SHUTOFF APPROACHES
CONTINUES TO CLOSELY MONITOR STATEWIDE FIRE WEATHER SYSTEM THAT COULD REQUIRE A PUBLIC SAFETY POWER SHUTOFF EVENT BEGINNING OCTOBER 14 EVENING
SAYS APPROXIMATELY 88,000 CUSTOMERS ACROSS 29 COUNTIES ARE CURRENTLY IN SCOPE FOR THE EVENT
SAYS IT WILL NOTIFY CUSTOMERS AGAIN WITHIN FOUR HOURS OF THEIR PLANNED POWER SHUTOFF
